priority_no_fit_analysis.fold_assignment: sort events by sha256('geofirex-threshold-v1:' + event_id), then rank modulo 5
priority_no_fit_analysis.calibration_rule: max new-fire recall under FPR<=0.00028; exact global ties; highest threshold on recall ties; reject-all feasible

assessment_acceptance.ranking_AP_and_Brier: unchanged probabilities; report, do not claim a gain

priority_no_fit_analysis.interpretation: post-baseline exploratory event-disjoint development crossfit; not a new blind validation
priority_no_fit_analysis.final_threshold: after assessment and a separate decision, refit the fixed calibration rule on all 80 development events and lock; never tune using 2021

priority_single_future_fit.sampler: unchanged LocalitySampler seed42 block256, each tile once, same order as baseline

deferred_ablations_separate_authorizatio.sampling: train-only weights 2 for tiles with any valid new positive, 1 otherwise; 115900 draws with replacement per epoch
deferred_ablations_separate_authorizatio.exposure_comparability: same update budget but repeated and omitted train tiles; report unique coverage and repetitions, never describe as each tile once

comparison.applies_to: new training candidates only; threshold-only analysis uses its own assessment_acceptance
comparison.uncertainty: 2000 paired event-bootstrap resamples, seed20261121, for confusion-count metrics; no pixel independence or multi-seed significance claim

small_variant.observed_J_for_evaluation: unchanged explicit C8 mask; not a model input
small_variant.causal_scope: existing historically accepted static SRTM-derived channels only; no new per-asset or operational delivery claim
small_variant.role: scientific static-terrain control, lower priority than improving C8 propagation
